capabilities.title: End-to-end encrypted password manager with self-hosted server option
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Padloc: zero-knowledge e2e encrypted vault with cross-platform clients
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password manager. Padloc's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Secure Remote Password (SRP) authentication: authenticate without sending password
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Padloc: SRP for zero-knowledge auth to self-hosted server
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no remote password-authenticated vault server. Adding SRP without that product mode would create unused authentication infrastructure and a misleading security surface.

capabilities.title: PWA with full offline capability and background sync
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Padloc PWA: offline-first with background sync on reconnect
capabilities.reason: Background synchronization of protected data requires authenticated remote storage, conflict resolution, and recovery guarantees that Nexus does not provide. PWA/mobile expansion is explicitly deferred.

capabilities.title: Rich vault item types: password, secure note, credit card, identity, custom
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Padloc item types with custom field schema
capabilities.reason: Nexus VAULT is for intelligence artifacts, not personal credential types.
